introduction: Delaware SNAP provides grocery benefits to eligible households through an EBT card. DSS handles application screening and interviews.
description: Delaware SNAP provides grocery benefits to eligible households through an EBT card. DSS handles application screening and interviews.

sections.who: DSS reviews income, household relationships, residence and applicable status and work rules. Explain who lives together and shares food. Current rules can differ from older tables.
sections.get: Benefits can buy eligible foods from approved retailers. Non-food goods, delivery fees and most hot prepared foods cannot be paid for with SNAP.
sections.docs:

  • Recent pay stubs and other income information.
  • Rent, mortgage and utility records relevant to the case.
sections.apply:
1. Submit an application

    Use ASSIST or visit a Delaware State Service Center.

  2. Complete the interview

    Provide the evidence DSS requests to verify application details.

  3. Read the mailed decision

    Keep the notice. If you disagree, review its fair-hearing instructions.
sections.after: Tell DSS about an immediate lack of food. Ask for local food resources while awaiting the decision.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Delaware SNAP rules and application; ASSIST application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
